entries.question: In public url add the current module and concept number
entries.answer: Done — each course card now shows "MODULE 0X · CONCEPT 0Y · ACTIVE" instead of just the module number and concept title.

entries.question: It still showing 'just finished: ROC-AUC and PR-AUC' — we're actually at Calibration now, for RAG Atlas too the tracking looked off
entries.answer: Real bug found: the tracker file kept losing individual checkpoint writes (ML Atlas Concepts 5 and 6 had none at all), so the live-status line fell back to an hours-old stale entry instead of the truth. Fixed by only showing live detail when it matches the current concept from the reliable roadmap progress count, and staying silent otherwise.

entries.question: Please create a separate HTML file explaining in detail how the site is being built, what's being used, and versions — without disturbing concept building
entries.answer: Added how-it-works.html, linked from the top of the main status page. Covers the per-concept build pipeline, why it's strictly sequential, batching/orchestration, the per-module push cadence, the tracker's known limitations, the manual-takeover policy, this dashboard's own design, and the tech stack used.
